name: Koeksisters
summary: Plaited syrup-soaked doughnuts: twisted dough fried until golden and plunged into ice-cold spiced syrup, crisp outside and syrupy within.
about: Koeksisters are the Afrikaans plaited kind, distinct from the spiced, coconut-dusted Cape Malay koesister. They are a fixture of church bazaars, school fêtes and tea tables. The secret is hot dough into ice-cold syrup.
steps: The day before, make the syrup: heat the sugar and water in a saucepan over low heat, stirring, until the sugar dissolves completely. Add the cinnamon, ginger, lemon peel and juice and the cream of tartar.

Bring to the boil and boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Cool, pour into a bowl and refrigerate overnight. Before frying, divide it between two bowls and put one in the freezer; the syrup must be ice-cold.
For the dough, sift the flour, baking powder and salt into a bowl and rub in the butter with your fingertips until it looks like fine crumbs.

Beat the egg with 200 ml of the buttermilk and mix it in with a knife, adding more buttermilk a spoon at a time, until the dough just comes together. It should be soft but not sticky. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Roll the dough out on a floured surface to 1 cm thick and cut into strips 8 cm long and 3 cm wide. Make two cuts along each strip, leaving the top joined, to give three legs.
Plait the three legs tightly and pinch the ends together firmly so they do not unravel in the oil. Keep the shaped koeksisters covered while you work.
Heat the oil in a deep pot to 180 °C. Fry 4 or 5 at a time for 1½ to 2 minutes a side, until deep golden and cooked through; break one open to check the inside is not doughy.
Lift them out with a slotted spoon, let them drip for 2 seconds and drop them straight into one bowl of ice-cold syrup for 1 minute, turning once. Swap to the second bowl when the first warms up.
Lift onto a wire rack set over a tray to drain and set, about 30 minutes. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.
prepNote: Make the syrup the day before. Koeksisters keep a week in the fridge and freeze well.
